name: Geometri baru · sesuai geometri
unit_note: Koordinat dipertahankan persis dari GH. Dokumen Rhino menyebut centimeters; konversi satuan fisik belum ditetapkan. Panjang ditampilkan dalam unit GH, tanpa klaim massa atau FE.

anchors.meaning: points per closed boundary, not total anchors

gap.meaning: native GH Offset Surface at exported slider stations

panels.meaning: exact count of full-domain UV cells; parent Loft fixed

algorithm.panel_layout: exact-count staggered Voronoi on fixed full UV square; native GH source port
algorithm.curve_division: equal arc length on closed polyline, N points; no repeated seam point
algorithm.first_layer: B (native P input); then A (native Lower input)
algorithm.sequence: next=(index+shift+1)%N; alternate boundary; close when index=0 AND layer=0
algorithm.partial_orbit: Retained exactly; visited and available anchors reported separately
